extras: The plugin fetches public data. It includes a dual rank system (CORE vs CCF) and supports 7 languages.
intentEvidence: CS conference deadline countdowns inside your vault: sidebar panel, in-note deadline boards, frontmatter-linked countdown banners and status-bar badge.
problem: Researchers struggle to track submission deadlines for numerous conferences across various fields, especially when abstract deadlines differ from final paper deadlines.

relations.evidence: Inspired by ccfddl and aideadlin.es; differentiated by personalization and calendar integration.
Inspired by ccfddl and aideadlin.es; differentiated by personalization and calendar integration.

summary: A CS conference deadline tracker that provides live countdown panels, status bar badges, and in-note deadline boards within Obsidian.
